fit.title: Is this trip right for you?
fit.weighUp: Worth weighing up before you book:

grades.Easy: Mostly vehicle-based safaris, walks in lodge grounds and gentle trails. Suits most fitness levels, including families.
grades.Moderate: More walking on uneven forest trails, some climbs, early starts and more exposure to rain, heat or cold. Needs basic fitness and comfort outdoors.
grades.Challenging: Longer walks, higher altitude, steep trails, remote habitat or long field hours. Needs good fitness and stamina.

westernGhatsEndemics.pace: Moderate, and on the move: {bases, plural, =3 {three bases} =4 {four bases} =5 {five bases} =6 {six bases} =7 {seven bases} =8 {eight bases} =9 {nine bases} =10 {ten bases} =11 {eleven bases} =12 {twelve bases} one {# base} other {# bases}} in {days, plural, =3 {three days} =4 {four days} =5 {five days} =6 {six days} =7 {seven days} =8 {eight days} =9 {nine days} =10 {ten days} =11 {eleven days} =12 {twelve days} one {# day} other {# days}} ({places}), so you pack up and move on {moves, plural, =2 {two times} =3 {three times} =4 {four times} =5 {five times} =6 {six times} =7 {seven times} =8 {eight times} =9 {nine times} =10 {ten times} =11 {eleven times} =12 {twelve times} one {# time} other {# times}}.
westernGhatsEndemics.terrain: Lowland forest at Thattekad, shola forest and grassland on the high ground at Pampadum Shola and Mukurthi, the Nilgiri tahr country of Eravikulam, and rain-shadow forest at Chinnar.
westernGhatsEndemics.rhythm: Cool to cold mornings on the high ground around Munnar and Ooty, and possible showers from the north-east monsoon between October and December.

mayNotSuit.roads: Time on the road: the route crosses Kerala, Tamil Nadu and Karnataka, with transfers between bases on hill roads. If you would rather unpack once, ask about a private trip with fewer bases.
mayNotSuit.footing: Uneven ground on the high shola-grassland walks at Mukurthi, Avalanche and Emerald, which need steady footing and basic fitness.

monsoonRainforestNights.pace: Moderate, with the main sessions after dark: guided night walks for frogs, geckos, snakes, owls and moths. Day {day} starts with a slower morning.
monsoonRainforestNights.terrain: Forest edges and stream banks in monsoon rain, often walked after dark by headlamp. Sturdy waterproof boots matter here.
monsoonRainforestNights.rhythm: Rain is part of the trip: the monsoon is when amphibians are most active. Bring reliable rain gear and a dry bag for electronics.

mayNotSuit.leeches: Leeches are common on wet forest paths in the monsoon. Long trousers and sturdy boots help.
mayNotSuit.snakes: Snakes are among the animals we look for. We watch them only from a safe distance with a guide, but if snakes worry you, this trip may not be for you.
mayNotSuit.footing: Late evenings on uneven, wet ground in the dark, which needs steady footing.

centralIndiaBigCats.pace: Easy. Most wildlife watching is from a safari jeep, walks stay in lodge grounds and buffer forest, and there is downtime between drives. Day {day} is a lighter day.
centralIndiaBigCats.terrain: Dry forest, meadows, waterholes and rocky forest edges, seen mostly from the vehicle.
centralIndiaBigCats.rhythm: Safari days have a morning and an afternoon drive. Early-morning drives can be cool, so bring a light jacket.

mayNotSuit.patience: Big-cat watching takes patience: long, quiet spells in the jeep, with no promise that a tiger will appear.
mayNotSuit.heat: Heat late in the season: daytime highs in central India can pass 40 °C by the end of May.
mayNotSuit.nightDrives: No night drives: night tourism is not permitted inside tiger reserves, so after-dark birding is in lodge grounds outside the reserve.

himalayaBirdsMountainWildlife.pace: Moderate, at a flexible walking pace with warm meals and rest breaks built in, and a slower afternoon on Day {day}.
himalayaBirdsMountainWildlife.terrain: Forest trails through oak, pine and rhododendron, a ridge route with viewpoints, and village paths.
himalayaBirdsMountainWildlife.rhythm: Dawn starts for birding, and cold mornings in the mountains: bring warm layers.

mayNotSuit.altitude: Higher ground: Day {day} visits a higher forest belt. If you have a heart or breathing condition, tell us before you book.
mayNotSuit.conditions: A plan that bends to the mountains: the high forest day runs only if conditions allow.

western-ghats-endemics.title: Western Ghats Birding & Wildlife Tour: 10 Days
western-ghats-endemics.description: Ten days through the UNESCO-listed Western Ghats with a naturalist: endemic birds, Nilgiri tahr, lion-tailed macaques and shola grasslands.

monsoon-rainforest-nights.title: Monsoon Herping & Rainforest Night-Walk Tour: 5 Days
monsoon-rainforest-nights.description: Five monsoon days in India’s rainforests with a naturalist: frogs, geckos and pit vipers on guided night walks, plus hornbills and butterflies.

central-india-big-cats.title: Central India Tiger Safari: 7-Day Big Cats Tour
central-india-big-cats.description: Seven days in central India’s tiger country with a naturalist: tigers, leopards and wild dogs, plus owls, raptors and dry-forest birds.

himalaya-birds-mountain-wildlife.title: Himalayan Birding Tour: 6 Days of Birds & Wildlife
himalaya-birds-mountain-wildlife.description: Six days of Himalayan birding with a naturalist: pheasants, laughingthrushes and woodpeckers, forest mammals, mountain villages and views.
